spec.rationale: Types the reported-cash leg of the cycle_reserve prose falsifier for the capital-cycle reserve (negative 60 dollars per share low / negative 20 base / negative 5 high). **[Fact]** The midcycle_capacity_value proof prices prolonged AI capital spending and retail competition as a per-share reserve, not as a separate SEC line item. **[Fact]** Q3 2025 TTM normalized owner earnings replay at 10,560 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm (TTM operating cash flow less TTM capital expenditures). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 TTM normalized owner earnings resolve to negative 2,472 USD millions on the same recipe (AMZN/investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-Q_20260430_rpt20260331_acc0001018724_26_000014.htm; verified with resolve_spec on 2026-10-09). **[Inference]** A Q3 2026 TTM outcome below negative 10,000 USD millions would signal further deterioration beyond the already-negative Q1 2026 trough, supporting movement of the reserve from the negative 20 dollars per share base toward the negative 60 dollars per share low case. **[Inference]** A 35 percent fire probability sits between the reinvestment_runway zero threshold (55 percent; already breached at cutoff) and the core_engine negative 25 billion USD tail (20 percent), preserving monotonic severity on nested thresholds. Target Q3 2026 TTM is not observable at registration.
